items.title: Negative Space Hidden Logos
items.content_snippet: Raymond Nickerson and Marilyn Adams tested this in 1979 with something more familiar than any logo. They asked American adults to draw a penny from memory. items.title: Experiment with SVG & 3D Design with the Codex Plugin
items.content_snippet: Craig Dennis had never drawn an SVG by hand or used Blender. With the SVG & 3D Design plugin for Codex, he shows how to turn a reference image into an editable graphic or 3D model, then ask for changes in plain language. See how a small change in SVG code can make a character’s eyes follow your cursor, and how Codex uses Blender to check a model from another angle. Enable SVG & 3D Design in Codex and tell us what you build! Learn more: SVG & 3D Design Plugin: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/Plugin_1
